text:
ariane: Heads-up — provisioning attempts to spin up GPU nodes in eu-west-1 are failing with KMS errors since ~09:12 UTC. Stacks stuck in PREPARING. Error snippet:
```
Error: AccessDeniedException: Unable to decrypt with KMS key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abc123
RequestId: 3f4b2a...
```
Anyone else seeing this?

mathias: seeing same. Occurs for both Dedicated and Private eu1 clusters. Started after the key policy change earlier today by security team? @security

security: we rolled a tighter deny on the shared kms key at 09:05 to block cross-account access. We thought the compute service principal was explicitly allowed. Will check now.

jasmine: impact note — provisioning throttles -> autoscaler keeps retrying -> queueing requests -> fallback to other regions. Cost impact ~ $1.2k extra in the past hour from cross-region fallbacks and retries. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.local/costs (truncated)

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1220 — KMS Decrypt failures in eu-west-1. Pager notified.

sre-lead: short-term mitigation: can we either rollback the policy or add an explicit Allow for the provisioner role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-provisioner? We need nodes back up ASAP.

security: I can add a scoped Allow for that role with an encryption-context condition (so we don't re-open cross-account access). Pushing change in ~5m and will post the change-id.

mathias: ping when done — we have 27 pending GPU jobs blocking CI and a couple of customer requests.

security-bot: Applied policy patch cp-784 at 09:24 UTC. Patch diff: +Allow arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-provisioner -> kms:Decrypt (Condition: StringEquals kms:EncryptionContext: {service:provisioner}) ; -no-other-changes.

ops-bot: Autoscaler resumed provisioning in eu-west-1 at 09:26 UTC — 24 nodes provisioned. Autoscaler events: `scale up` x3.

ariane: Confirming nodes report healthy and join clusters. Running quick smoke evals now.

jasmine: long-term: recommend adding a Policy Change CI test that simulates KMS key policy changes against a staging provisioner role to catch removal of service allows. Also add a cost guard that alerts on cross-region provisioning spend above threshold.

security: agreed. I'll open an RFC (sec-ops-2026-07) to require: 1) deploy-time check for service principal access, 2) policy-change alerting on deny/allow flips for critical keys, 3) post-change automated smoke provisioning.

mathias: thanks — can we also add a short runbook step to check CloudTrail KMS events and quickly re-add the allow if we detect failures? That saved us some time this morning.

security: adding that to the incident notes. Will attach CloudTrail query and the exact IAM principal to the RFC.

jasmine: :thumbsup: and let's retro on the cost hit in the weekly infra sync.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1220 marked RESOLVED at 09:40 UTC. Root cause: KMS key policy tightened without explicit allow for provisioner service role. Mitigation: scoped Allow re-added. Follow-ups tracked in RFC and tickets.
